rentTypical1brUsd.sourceId: Statistics Portugal (INE) · Median rent per m² of new lease contracts, by municipality (indicator 0012600)
rentTypical1brUsd.method: Typical one-bedroom rent = median rent per m² of new leases in 2024 × 45 m². Ericeira uses its own parish row. National reference: the Portugal figure. rentPreviousBenchmarkUsd.sourceId: US Census Bureau · Median gross rent by bedrooms (table B25031), American Community Survey 5-year, 2020–2024
rentPreviousBenchmarkUsd.method: Typical one-bedroom rent = median gross rent (rent plus utilities) of one-bedroom units, all renter households, in the city's Census place; a five-year average of the whole rental stock, so below current asking rents. US cities are priced from BEA price parities; this table supplies the rent shown, the calibration of the rent weight used elsewhere, and the rent adjustment of the three US cities outside a BEA metro (Hilo, Key West, Park City). Input: scripts/build-dataset/inputs/rents-us.csv.

rentTypical1brUsd.sourceId: Statistics Canada / Canada Mortgage and Housing Corporation · Average rents by bedroom type, Rental Market Survey (table 34-10-0133-01), October 2025
rentTypical1brUsd.method: Typical one-bedroom rent = average rent of one-bedroom units in purpose-built apartment structures of three units and over, by census metropolitan area; existing tenancies, so below asking rents. The table has no national row, so the cost adjustment compares each city's two-bedroom average with CMHC's national two-bedroom average (Canada 10,000+, C$1,550, Rental Market Report 2025, Table 1.0). Where a city has no city-level cost, its national estimate is scaled by its rent: national × (1 + s × (rent ÷ national rent − 1)), with s, the weight of rent in the price level, fitted in each build on US cities against BEA price parities. Whistler and Banff are not surveyed; Whitehorse is suppressed. Input: scripts/build-dataset/inputs/rents-ca.csv.

rent1brUsd.sourceId: Ministry of Business, Innovation and Employment, New Zealand · Auckland Central 1-bedroom median
rent1brUsd.method: Median weekly one-bedroom apartment rent in Auckland Central from active April–September or March–August rental-bond records as dated above. Weekly NZD × 52 ÷ 12 × 1.0992 (USD/EUR) ÷ 1.9890 (NZD/EUR), rounded to nearest USD. Not citywide or representative of furnished rentals.
